name: stats_by_group
jq: group_agg({g}; map(.x) | {n: count_nonnull, sum: sum_nonnull, mean: mean, var_samp: var_samp, var_pop: var_pop, sd_samp: stddev_samp, sd_pop: stddev_pop, qd: quantiles_disc([0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1]), qc: quantiles_cont([0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1]), median: median})

name: round_to
jq: map({i, r2: (.x | round_to(2)), r0: (.x | round_to(0))})

name: parse_and_local
jq: map(.i as $i | (.s | parse_ts) as $e | {i: $i, epoch: $e, det: ($e | local_time("America/Detroit") | {date, hour, minute, weekday, offset_s}), lon: ($e | local_time("Europe/London") | {date, hour, weekday, offset_s})})

name: join_inner
jq: ($right | map({ri, rk: .k, rv})) as $r | join_inner($r; .k; .rk) | map({id, lk: .k, lv, ri, rv})

name: join_left
jq: ($right | map({ri, rk: .k, rv})) as $r | join_left($r; .k; .rk) | map({id, lk: .k, lv, ri, rv})

name: join_full
jq: ($right | map({ri, rk: .k, rv})) as $r | join_full($r; .k; .rk) | map({id, lk: .k, lv, ri, rv})

name: join_semi_anti
jq: {semi: (join_semi($right; .k; .k) | map(.id)), anti: (join_anti($right; .k; .k) | map(.id))}

name: join_asof
jq: ($right | map({qi, k, qt: .t, q})) as $q | join_asof($q; .k; .k; .t; .qt) | map({id, qi, q})

name: windows
jq: over(.g; .t; "rn"; row_number) | over(.g; .t; "lag1"; lag(.v; 1)) | over(.g; .t; "rs"; running_sum(.v)) | over(.g; .t; "rk"; rank_by(.t)) | over(.g; .t; "mm"; moving_mean(.v; 2)) | map({i, rn, lag1, rs, rk, mm})

name: unpivot
jq: unpivot(["id"]; "col"; "val")

name: pivot
jq: pivot(["a", "b", "c"]; {id}; .col; .v; add)

name: group_order
jq: group_agg({g}; {n: length, total: (map(.x) | sum_nonnull)})

name: unpivot_field_order
jq: unpivot(["id"]; "col"; "val")

name: cast
jq: cast({n: "number", t: "timestamp", b: "boolean"}) | map({i, n, t, b})

name: cast_error
jq: cast({n: "number"})

name: split_by_shape
jq: split_by(.event_type) | shape | map_values(.rows)

name: keep_tables
jq: split_by(.event_type) | keep(["firewall"]) | shape | map_values(.fields)

name: join_on_range_left
jq: join_on($right; .region; .region; .l.amount >= .r.lo and .l.amount < .r.hi; "left") | map({id, bi, band})

name: join_on_no_key
jq: join_on($right | map({bi, lo, hi}); true; true; .l.amount >= .r.lo and .l.amount < .r.hi; "inner") | map({id, bi})

name: join_on_full_cond
jq: join_on($right | map({bi, rregion: .region, lo, hi}); .region; .rregion; .l.amount >= .r.lo and .l.amount < .r.hi; "full") | map({id, bi})

name: join_on_semi_anti_cond
jq: {semi: (join_on($right; .region; .region; .l.amount >= .r.lo and .l.amount < .r.hi; "semi") | map(.id)), anti: (join_on($right; .region; .region; .l.amount >= .r.lo and .l.amount < .r.hi; "anti") | map(.id))}

name: join_nest
jq: join_nest($right; .region; .region; .l.amount >= .r.lo and .l.amount < .r.hi; "bands") | map({id, bands: (.bands | map(.band))})

name: lookup
jq: lookup($right; .gid; .gid; "g") | map({id, gname: .g.gname})

name: lookup_duplicate_error
jq: lookup($right; .gid; .gid; "g")

name: join_clash_error
jq: join_inner($right; .k; .k)

name: join_overlap
jq: join_overlap($right; .host; .host; .start; .end; .ostart; .oend) | map({sid, oid})

name: join_asof_max_age
jq: ($right | map({qi, k, qt: .t, q})) as $q | join_asof($q; .k; .k; .t; .qt; 3) | map({id, qi, q})

name: state_blocks
jq: state_blocks({u}; .t; .s)

name: transitions
jq: transitions({u}; .t; .s)

name: sessions
jq: sessions({u}; .t; 10)

name: runs
jq: runs(.s)

name: tree_cycle_error
jq: tree_paths(.id; .parent)

name: tree_orphan_error
jq: tree_paths(.id; .parent)

name: reachable
jq: {from_1: (reachable(.a; .b; 1) | sort), from_7: (reachable(.a; .b; 7) | sort)}

name: components
jq: components(.a; .b)

name: example_05_asof_join
jq: split_by(.event_type) | .leases = (.dhcp | map({ip: .ip_address, user, lease_t: (._time | tonumber)})) | .hits = (.firewall | map({ip: .src_ip, t: (._time | tonumber)})) | .joined = (.leases as $leases | .hits | join_asof($leases; .ip; .ip; .t; .lease_t; 300)) | .joined | map({_time: .t, ip, user}) | sort_by(._time)

name: example_10_state_dwell
jq: map(.t = (._time | tonumber)) | state_blocks({ticket_id}; .t; .status) | map(select(.end != null) | {ticket_id, state, duration_seconds: .duration}) | sort_by(.ticket_id, .state)

name: example_21_hierarchy_rollup
jq: map(.own_cost = (.cost | tonumber)) | (map({key: .node_id, value: .name}) | from_entries) as $name | tree_rollup(.node_id; .parent_id; .own_cost) | map({node_id, parent_id, name, cost, depth, path: (.ancestry | map($name[.]) | join(" / ")), own_cost, subtree_cost: .subtree})

name: context_sales_levels
jq: def revenue: map(.qty * .price) | add; rollup_levels([["region", "product"], ["region"], ["product"], []]; {revenue: measure(revenue), share_of_region: (share(revenue; without("product")) | round_to(4)), share_of_all: (share(revenue; keep_only([])) | round_to(4)), a_revenue: calc(revenue; with_filter({product: "A"}))}) | map(del(.level) | {region: null, product: null} + .)

name: context_sales_time
jq: def revenue: map(.qty * .price) | add; rollup(["region", "month"]; {revenue: measure(revenue), prior: calc(revenue; shift("month"; -1)), to_date: calc(revenue; to_date("month"))}) | map(del(.level) | {region: null, month: null} + .)

name: context_scan_fallback
jq: def revenue: map(.qty * .price) | add; rollup_levels([["region", "product"]]; {share_of_region: (share(revenue; without("product")) | round_to(4)), months_to_feb: calc(length; with_filter({month: {from: "2026-01", to: "2026-02"}}))}) | map(del(.level))

name: context_empty_input
jq: [] | rollup(["a"]; {n: measure(length)})

name: context_missing_level_field
jq: [{g: "a", x: 1}, {x: 2}, {g: "a", x: 3}] | rollup(["g"]; {n: measure(length), all: calc(length; without("g")), next: calc(length; shift("g"; 1)), upto: calc(length; to_date("g"))})

name: made_up_resolved_summary
jq: map(.opened = (.opened_at | parse_ts) | .resolved = (.resolved_at | parse_ts) | .hours = hours_between(.opened; .resolved)) | map(.hours) as $h | {incidents: length, unresolved: (map(select(.resolved == null)) | length), resolved: ($h | count_nonnull), mean: ($h | mean | round_to(2)), p25: ($h | quantile_disc(0.25) | round_to(2)), p50: ($h | quantile_disc(0.5) | round_to(2)), p75: ($h | quantile_disc(0.75) | round_to(2)), p90: ($h | quantile_disc(0.9) | round_to(2)), max: ($h | nonnull | max | round_to(2)), within_1h: ($h | map(select(. != null and . <= 1)) | length), within_1d: ($h | map(select(. != null and . <= 24)) | length), within_7d: ($h | map(select(. != null and . <= 168)) | length)}

name: made_up_office_hours
jq: tz("America/Detroit") as $det | map(.opened = (.opened_at | parse_ts) | .resolved = (.resolved_at | parse_ts) | .hours = hours_between(.opened; .resolved)) | map(select(.resolved != null) | (.opened | local_time($det)) as $o | .in_hours = ($o.weekday >= 1 and $o.weekday <= 5 and $o.hour >= 8 and $o.hour <= 16) | .rhour = (.resolved | local_time($det) | .hour)) | {inside: (map(select(.in_hours) | .hours) | {n: length, median: (quantile_disc(0.5) | round_to(2)), p90: (quantile_disc(0.9) | round_to(2))}), outside: (map(select(.in_hours | not) | .hours) | {n: length, median: (quantile_disc(0.5) | round_to(2)), p90: (quantile_disc(0.9) | round_to(2))}), by_resolved_hour: (group_agg({hour: .rhour}; {n: length}) | sort_by(.hour))}

name: made_up_top_days
jq: tz("America/Detroit") as $det | map({day: (.opened_at | parse_ts | local_time($det) | .date)}) | group_agg({day}; {n: length}) | sort_by([-.n, .day]) | .[:5]

name: made_up_lag_within_day
jq: tz("America/Detroit") as $det | map(.opened = (.opened_at | parse_ts) | .day = (.opened | local_time($det) | .date)) | over(.day; .opened; "prev"; lag(.opened; 1)) | over(.day; .opened; "rn"; row_number) | map(if .prev == null then null else (.opened - .prev) / 3600 end) as $g | {days: (map(.day) | unique | length), gaps: ($g | count_nonnull), median: ($g | quantile_cont(0.5) | round_to(4)), p90: ($g | quantile_disc(0.9) | round_to(4)), max_rn: (map(.rn) | max)}

name: made_up_asof_last_resolution
jq: map(.opened = (.opened_at | parse_ts) | .resolved = (.resolved_at | parse_ts)) as $rows | ($rows | map(select(.resolved != null) | {ag: .assignment_group, rt: .resolved})) as $res | $rows | join_asof($res; .assignment_group; .ag; .opened; .rt) | map(if .rt == null then null else (.opened - .rt) / 3600 end) as $g | {incidents: length, matched: ($g | count_nonnull), median: ($g | quantile_disc(0.5) | round_to(4)), p90: ($g | quantile_disc(0.9) | round_to(4))}

name: made_up_day_volume_join
jq: tz("America/Detroit") as $det | map(.opened = (.opened_at | parse_ts) | .resolved = (.resolved_at | parse_ts) | .hours = hours_between(.opened; .resolved) | .day = (.opened | local_time($det) | .date)) | (group_agg({day}; {n: length}) | map({vday: .day, n})) as $v | join_inner($v; .day; .vday) | {busy: (map(select(.n >= 100)) | {n: length, mean: (map(.hours) | mean | round_to(4))}), quiet: (map(select(.n < 100)) | {n: length, mean: (map(.hours) | mean | round_to(4))})}

name: made_up_context_months
jq: def requests: length; def share_within_day: if length == 0 then null else (map(select(.hours != null and .hours <= 24)) | length) / length end; def open_at($d): map(select(.day <= $d and (.resolved_day == null or .resolved_day > $d))) | length; map(. + {month: .opened_at[0:7], day: .opened_at[0:10], resolved_day: (if .resolved_at == "" then null else .resolved_at[0:10] end), hours: hours_between(.opened_at | parse_ts; .resolved_at | parse_ts)}) | rollup(["month"]; {requests: measure(requests), share_of_all: (share(requests; without("month")) | round_to(4)), within_day: (measure(share_within_day) | round_to(4)), prior_within_day: (calc(share_within_day; shift("month"; -1)) | round_to(4)), median_hours: (measure(map(.hours) | median) | round_to(2)), requests_to_date: calc(requests; to_date("month")), open_at_end: ((.rows | map(.day) | max) as $d | .all | open_at($d))}) | map(del(.level) | {month: null} + .)

name: made_up_context_two_levels
jq: map(. + {month: .opened_at[0:7]}) | rollup(["month", "state"]; {requests: measure(length), share_of_month: (if .at | has("month") then share(length; without("state")) | round_to(4) else null end)}) | map(del(.level) | {month: null, state: null} + .) | sort_by(.month == null, .month, .state == null, .state)

name: malloy_nest
jq: def rev: map(.qty * .price) | add; rollup(["region"]; {revenue: measure(rev), top_products: measure(group_agg({product}; {rev: rev}) | sort_by(-.rev, .product) | .[0:2])}) | map(select(.level == "region") | {region, revenue, top_products})

name: malloy_all_exclude
jq: def rev: map(.qty * .price) | add; rollup_levels([["region", "product"]]; {revenue: measure(rev), total: calc(rev; keep_only([])), region_total: calc(rev; keep_only(["region"])), product_total: calc(rev; without("region"))}) | map(del(.level))
